name: entity_type
description: The kind of entity the detection is about: 'video' or 'channel'.

name: entity_id
description: The YouTube video ID or channel ID.

name: modality
description: The text the detection was made in: 'title', 'description' or 'tags'.

name: source
description: Where the signal came from. Currently always 'first_party'.

name: detector
description: The detector that produced the row. Currently always 'keyword_match'.

name: detector_version
description: Hand-maintained version of the detection rules, bumped whenever pattern construction changes, so rows written under different rules can be told apart after the fact.

name: taxonomy
description: The classification namespace the label belongs to. Currently always 'advertiser_blocklist.keyword'. Consumers filter on this rather than on detector identity.

name: label
description: The matched keyword, in its normalised (trimmed, lowercased) form.

name: score
description: Detector confidence. NULL for the keyword detector, which is deterministic.

name: evidence
description: Detector-specific supporting detail. Unused by the keyword detector.

name: first_detected_at
description: When this detection was first observed. Preserved across merges.

name: last_detected_at
description: When this detection was most recently observed.

name: expires_at
description: When the detection should stop being treated as current. Unused by the keyword detector.

name: retracted_at
description: When the detection was withdrawn, e.g. because its keyword left the sheet. Rows are retracted rather than deleted so history survives.
